quests.title: Room for a Loaded Step
quests.text: A carrier watches the path less easily with a load across both shoulders. Loosen the old snare at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/carrier_clearing} and clear it from their passage. Whoever set it has had quite enough of the forest's patience.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft ER1: a use at the new recipe place P7 (Skyglass clearings); Eriath's work from 51.

quests.title: Enough for Another Cup
quests.text: The people tending our distant work sites have taken to stretching one pot across a whole shift. Bring me six Wild Cocoa so I can send something worth warming their hands around. A second cup is a small kindness, until you are the person who would otherwise go without it.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).

quests.title: Received in Good Order
quests.text: A supply load has reached the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/receiving_stand}, but our carriers still need its arrival entered. Confirm the delivery on the dispatch record there. Then I can tell the crews what is waiting for them, and the people who hauled it can stop answering for a journey already made.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft ER3: a use at the new recipe place P8 (Skyglass rootways).

quests.title: More Than a Lost Watch
quests.text: The report from {name:r20_anchor_085} calls them a lost watch and leaves a space where their names should be. Secure the names and personal records left there, so I can give their people something more exact than a number. Someone in Lethariel may have been listening for one particular footstep.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft ER4: a use at the free clash site 085; Lethariel's weapon (a solo quest).

quests.title: The Price of Another War
quests.text: I have seen this hand before, in Bough-Counter Rusk's false reckonings; in {name:paymaster_chirr}'s payroll it has grown bold, writing names from both armies in the open. A living recruit who takes this coin cannot spend or discard it; it cools only when passed on as payment for a death. Defeat five Last-Pay Archers or Ash-Writ Bowmen in all at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}, where they guard the pay day and night. Kill Chirr too, before he buys another generation beneath these branches.
quests.completion: Chirr paid living and dead alike with coin taken from both armies; his death stops his hand, but leaves the names he burned into root and stone. I can point you to the rootmark at {name:r20_anchor_084} and the tally-stone at {name:r20_anchor_077}, where those claims still hold. Break their hold on the names, then report to the Warmaster at Ashenward Bastion; the collector will answer to an army, not to a forest left alone.
quests.lesson: Front climax and the main line's chapter 3 climax: the last named normal leader before 60.

quests.title: Names Beyond His Reach
quests.text: Chirr's purse held coins stripped from both armies' dead, and the Undertithe claims every name bought with them. Smother the burning rootmark at {name:r20_anchor_084} and strike the names from the tally-stone at {name:r20_anchor_077} in Gravesalt Escarpment. Without those names to secure the debt, its unpaid balance will draw the collector to the stone. Report to the Warmaster at {name:pvp_fortress_accord}; we have freed the names and made ourselves an appointment.
quests.completion: The names are struck from root and stone, and I will preserve them in our own record, Odren Vell's included. The unsecured claim is drawing its collector to {name:r20_anchor_077}: Isquarre the Tithe-Eater, whose reach beneath the ground we cannot measure. I will commission a group to meet him there; no one is to mistake this for a task to attempt alone.

objectives.label: Strike the names from the tally

quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 3 (last turn-in): two uses, at a Skyglass clash site and at Tombroad Ambush, then back to the Warmaster.

quests.title: Party: Beneath the Waiting Coils
quests.text: {name:glass_throat_serpent} has fattened among the scorched branches of the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}, {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}. Whatever becomes of Chirr's payroll, our watchers still cannot cross beneath those coils. Gather a party and slay the elite serpent; a forest worth keeping should leave room for someone to walk through it.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 60 without it.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft ER5 (K11 A): the optional group quest on Glass-Throat, standalone from its level; its id and objective stay, its prerequisite goes; a trinket choice.
